name: eaglecross
description: Research B2B leads for recent buying signals, see who to contact now, and get a personalized cold-email subject and opening line for each.

interface.longDescription:
Eaglecross turns a list of B2B prospects into a prioritized outreach plan.

Give it companies and, ideally, the contact's name and title. Eaglecross scans each company's website, news, job posts and tech stack for recent buying signals such as sales hiring, funding rounds, product launches and leadership changes, with links to every source. It scores each lead against your Ideal Customer Profile, flags who is worth contacting now, and writes a personalized email subject line and opening line grounded in the signals it found.

Ask ChatGPT to research a list of leads, show who to reach out to this week and why, explain the signals behind a lead, rewrite an opener in a different tone, or review jobs you ran in the Eaglecross web app. Eaglecross never sends emails on your behalf.
defaultPrompt: Research Linear (linear.app), CEO Karri Saarinen, and tell me if I should reach out
Which leads from my latest Eaglecross job are worth emailing this week?
Rewrite the icebreaker for my top lead to be more casual and under 25 words

positive.description: Account overview: connected account and default ICP preset.
positive.prompt: Which Eaglecross account is connected, and which ICP preset is my default?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the connected account's email and its default ICP preset. It shows no prices, plans to buy or upgrade links.

positive.description: Research one new lead end to end and give a verdict with sources.
positive.prompt: Research Linear (linear.app), CEO Karri Saarinen, and tell me if I should reach out.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts a 1-lead job, checks progress until done, then says whether the lead is 'reach' or 'skip', cites the signals with source links, and shows the subject line and opener if one was written.

positive.description: Review results of an existing job.
positive.prompt: Show me the leads from my most recent Eaglecross job, best first.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the reviewer's demo job 'Reviewer demo - SaaS founders' and lists its leads with verdict, score and reason.

positive.description: Explain why a lead was scored the way it was.
positive.prompt: Why did Eaglecross score Vercel the way it did? Show the evidence.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens the Vercel lead and explains the score using its signals, intent summary and reach reason, with source URLs where available.

positive.description: Rewrite an opener with the user's instructions.
positive.prompt: Rewrite the Figma icebreaker from my latest job: casual tone, under 25 words.
positive.expected_behavior: Rewrites the Figma lead's subject and opener following the instructions (costs 1 credit) and shows the new text.

negative.description: Out of scope, sending email. Eaglecross only researches and drafts; no tool sends messages, so it should explain that and offer the drafted opener to copy.
negative.prompt: Email all the reach leads from my last job for me.

negative.description: Large job without confirmation. Research spends credits, so it should state the cost and ask before calling research_leads.
negative.prompt: Research these 300 companies right now: (long list).

negative.description: Another account's data. Tools only return the signed-in user's jobs, so it should say it can't access other customers' data.
negative.prompt: Show me the leads my competitor researched in Eaglecross.

review.commerce_description: The plugin sells nothing and starts no purchase. Users sign in to their existing Eaglecross account, and research uses the credits already in that account. The plugin shows no prices, plans for sale, upgrade prompts or links to pricing or checkout pages. If an account has no credits left, it only says so.

publication.release_notes: First release. Connect your Eaglecross account to research B2B leads for buying signals, track research jobs, see which leads to contact with the evidence behind each, and get or rewrite personalized email openers.
